name: Stable Complement Duality of Coefficient Spaces
statement: For nonempty proper $C$ and $0<t\le1$, the threshold spaces satisfy $\mathcal A_t(C)\times\mathbb R^{d_{C^c}}\cong\mathcal A_t(C^c)\times\mathbb R^{d_C}$ and hence are homotopy equivalent. Therefore $\min(1,\tau(C))=\min(1,\tau(C^c))$; below one the values are equal.
proof: A symmetric bilinear relation projects exactly onto both threshold coefficient spaces. Minimum-norm centers and radial trivializations identify it with each space times the corresponding Euclidean fiber.
